raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "cellhint" %}
{% set version = "1.0.0" %}

package:
  name: "{{ name|lower }}"
  version: "{{ version }}"

source:
  url: "https://pypi.io/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz"
  sha256: b9fca2227b20b8342b29fd80ad974c4791b1c0bea0549ddebbf7248cb75c7498

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: "{{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv"

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python >=3.6
  run:
    - leidenalg >=0.9.0
    - numpy >=1.19.0
    - openpyxl >=3.0.4
    - pandas >=1.0.5
    - python >=3.6
    - scanpy >=1.7.0
    - scikit-learn >=0.24.1
    - python-annoy >=1.17.0

test:
  imports:
    - cellhint

about:
  home: "https://github.com/Teichlab/cellhint"
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: "A tool for semi-automatic cell type harmonization and integration"
  dev_url: "https://github.com/Teichlab/cellhint"
  doc_url: "https://github.com/Teichlab/cellhint"

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ChuanXu1
